GitHub - donghaoren/AlloVolume: Volume rendering for AMR data in the ...
CUDA-based AMR Ray-casting Volume Renderer. KD-Tree for fast ray-block intersection. Customizable lens. Pre-integration rendering method to produce high quality images fast. Z-indexing for better cache utilization. High definintion rendering using adaptive Runge-Kutta-Fehlberg method. HTML5-based Parameter Editor. Transfer function editing.
